Return the vector of 990-only financial field names (PC scope)

Source: R/globals.R
get_pc_fields.Rd

Returns financial fields that appear only on the full Form 990 (Parts VIII, IX, and X). These fields are not present on the 990-EZ. Used by sanitize_financials() to restrict zero-imputation to full 990 filers.

Usage

get_pc_fields()

Value

A character vector of column names.

Examples

get_pc_fields()
#>   [1] "F9_01_ACT_GVRN_UBIZ_REV_TOT"      "F9_01_ACT_GVRN_UBIZ_TAXABLE_NET" 
#>   [3] "F9_01_EXP_BEN_PAID_MEMB_PY"       "F9_01_EXP_FUNDR_TOT_CY"
